source.title: Emulative learning of a two-step task in free-ranging domestic pigs.

confidence_rationale: A well-controlled experiment with the decisive comparison built in: a 'ghost control' in which objects move with no agent present performed as well as a live conspecific demonstrator. This directly weakens the strong reading of H-bc-prior -- that what a learner needs is an ACTION-LEVEL policy to copy. What the pigs extracted was affordance information about the apparatus, obtainable without any demonstrator. Single species, single manipulative task, moderate n per group.
failure_signatures: Observers of ALL kinds still beat non-observers, so some external information source was required -- the result weakens 'a conspecific demonstrator is needed', not 'external information is needed'.

The task is a two-step manipulation of a fixed apparatus, where affordance information is nearly the whole problem; in a foraging task where the difficulty is action SELECTION over time, action-level copying might carry weight that it does not carry here.
Free-ranging adult pigs already possess a competent exploratory and manipulative repertoire, so this is skill acquisition on top of competence, not a cold-start bootstrap.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Free-ranging pigs given conspecific, human, ghost-control (self-moving objects), or ghost-plus-bystander demonstrations of a two-step foraging apparatus all solved it more often and engaged the relevant objects longer than non-observers, with NO difference between the four observer types -- indicating learning about the apparatus (emulation) rather than about the actions, and that social agents are not necessary.
mapping.ree_translation: What a demonstrator supplies may be information about the TASK STRUCTURE rather than a policy to imitate. For CDQ-007 this weakens the specifically imitative reading of H-bc-prior: if BC's floor-clearing score of 32.72 works because it transmits structure rather than because it transmits a policy, then an affordance/structure channel could substitute for the demonstrator without any behavioural cloning at all.
mapping.mapping_caveat: Observers of every type still outperformed non-observers, so this is evidence against the NECESSITY OF A CONSPECIFIC, not against the necessity of an external informational prior. The task is affordance-dominated (a fixed two-step apparatus); a temporally extended foraging policy may be a case where action-level information carries weight it does not carry here.
mapping.source_context: 36 free-ranging domestic pigs across four demonstration conditions plus 22 non-observer controls; two-step plug-and-slide foraging apparatus.

confidence_components.notes: The ghost-control design is exactly the right dissociation and is why this entry earns its place. Discounted for single-species, affordance-dominated task, and adult (non-cold-start) subjects.
